sourceInspection.effectStructure: All 12 candidates use materially different spatial motifs rather than recolors of one geometry: sparkles, clouds, pixels, hearts, botanical fireflies, planetary orbits, solar rays, bubbles, confetti, neon trails, aurora ribbons and starstorm rings.
sourceInspection.tierProgression: Directionally present in source complexity: Tier 1 uses sparse motif clusters; Tier 2 adds themed structures/orbits; Tier 3 adds broader radial or multi-element fields; Tier 4 adds continuous layered trails/ribbons; Tier 5 combines multiple orbit systems, trails and oversized star bursts.
